literal_meaning: বারবার নমস্কার বা প্রণাম (quick repeated bows or prostrations)
figurative_meaning_en: In a superficial or hasty manner
example_sentences_in_bangla: কাজটা নমো নমো করে শেষ করলাম।
example_sentences_in_english: I finished the puja by bowing hastily.
I rushed through the task with quick nods.
note: Refers to quick, perfunctory obeisance in Hindu rituals, common in Bengali traditions.
